rows.name: SKERRIES
rows.character: One occulting bright lt., 1 min. Lower fixed red light
rows.description: White tower, 75 ft. high. Upper lt. eclipsed 3 times in quick succession, followed by 50 secs. light; not visible over East Platters Rock, from S.S.E. to S.E. ½ S. Low red light shown over Ethel and Coal Rocks, from E. ½ S. to E. by N. ½ N.

rows.name: Amlwch Port
rows.description: On North pier; vis. betw. N.E. ½ N. & E. ½ N. Shown only when the harbour is practicable

rows.name: LYNUS or ELIAN POINT
rows.description: A white building, 36 ft. high. Light visible 8 secs.; eclipsed 2 secs. Masked to mark Middle Mouse and Dulas Rocks

rows.name: Beaumaris
rows.description: A fixed red light on pier

rows.name: Penrhyn
rows.description: Fix. green lt. on E. pier-hd.; red lt. on W. pier

rows.name: MENAI, TRWYN-DU PT.
rows.description: Tower, 96 ft. high, painted in black and white bands

rows.name: GREAT ORMES HEAD
rows.character: One fix. bright or red lt.
rows.description: Square gray building, on cliff of North point. Lt. bright from N.W. by W. ¾ W. to E. ½ N., thence red to E. ½ S.

rows.name: Llandudno
rows.description: On pier-head. Lower red light, or red flag, when it is dangerous to come alongside

rows.name: Rhyl
rows.description: A fixed bright light on pier-head

rows.name: River Dee Lightvessel
rows.description: In 8 fathoms, at river entrance, 7½ miles within the bar

rows.name: N.W. LIGHTSHIP
rows.character: One rev. br. lt., ½ min.
rows.description: In 13 fathoms, 8¾ miles N.W. ¼ W. from Horse Channel Fairway Buoy. Black, with white streak; a black ball on fore-mast

rows.name: BAR LIGHTVESSEL
rows.description: In 7½ fathoms, 8¾ miles N. ¾ W. from Hoylake lighthouse, and 8 miles E. by S. ½ S. from N.W. Lightship. Painted red. (It is intended to exhibit an experimental ELECTRIC light, showing a flash every half minute)

rows.name: Hoylake
rows.description: White towers, 64 and 42 ft. In line, S.W. by S. ½ S., 1,200 feet apart, near the church. Light shown from low tower, and obscured West of N. ¾ W. High light discontinued

rows.name: Leasowe
rows.description: White lighthouse, 110 feet high, on the shore, betw. the Mersey and Dee. Light is masked over the bay eastward of N.N.W.

rows.name: BIDSTON
rows.description: Stone tower, 68 ft. high, on the hill. Light is masked over bay eastward of N.W. by N. ¾ N.

rows.name: Dove Beacons
rows.description: One on each beacon. In line, S.E. ¾ S., 420 yds. apart, lead along channel till Rock and North Wall lights are in line E. ½ S.

rows.name: ROCK
rows.character: One rev. br. lt., ½ min.
rows.description: White tower, 94 ft. high. Also a lower fix. br. lt. down Rock Channel, and up the Mersey, or black ball, while 11 ft. water in Rock Gut

rows.name: North Docks Wall
rows.character: One fix. br. or red lt.
rows.description: Bright betw. S. by W. and N. by W. ¾ W., red over Formby Bank East of N. by W. ¾ W. In line with Rock light, bearing E. ½ S., indicates turning point betw. Horse and Rock Channels. In clear weather only, light is greatly diminished in intensity to South of W. by S.

rows.name: Birkenhead New Pier
rows.description: One fixed bright light

rows.name: Formby Lightvessel
rows.character: One rev. red lt., ½ m.
rows.description: At the elbow of Crosby and Queen's Channels, 3½ miles E.S.E. from Bar lightvessel. Hull black, two masts, black ball at fore

rows.name: Crosby Lightvessel
rows.description: In 27 ft., on North side of channel, off the N.E. elbow of Burbo Bank. Red, with red ball at fore

rows.name: Crosby Lighthouse
rows.description: Square white tower, 74 ft., N. of the point. Lt. visible seaward betw. W. & N.W. by N. ¾ N.

rows.name: Ribble River
rows.description: S.E. of Stanner Point. Light visible 3½ min.; dark ½ minute

rows.name: Lytham
rows.description: Tide light on new pier, from 2h. before to 1½h. after high water

rows.name: St. Anne's-on-Sea
rows.description: Two fixed red lights on ends of pier

rows.name: Southport
rows.description: A fixed bright light on pier-head
